slides.title: Google profile pe *"Post"* ka button hai. Use karte ho?
slides.sub: Free hai. Aur zyaadatar competitors ne kabhi use nahi kiya.

slides.title: Kya hai *Google post*?
slides.sub: Aapke Google profile pe photo + text + button. Search karne wale dekhte hain.

slides.title: Kya post karein: *4 ideas*
slides.box: Naya kaam · Offer · Customer ka sawaal-jawab · Team photo

slides.title: Har post mein *button*
slides.sub: "Call now" ya "Book". Bina button ke post adhoori hai.

slides.title: *Asli* photo
slides.sub: Stock photo nahi. Phone se khinchi apni dukaan, apna kaam.
